timing_identity_conclusion.strict_answer: No: every semantic row, emitted program, loadable section, native output, and instruction body is identical, but the regenerated Mach-O files are not byte identical because UUID, temporary-object symbol/string metadata, and the derived ad-hoc code signature differ. The retained r1 timing directly measures the frozen r1 Mach-O files, not these r2 regenerated files.
